approval.note: Explicitly approved as movement 2 of the complete Mozart Requiem K.626 Full Rendition queue.

source.attribution: PDMX (Long, Novack, McAuley, Berg-Kirkpatrick et al.); source surfaced through ScoreBase
source.compositionRights: Mozart's Requiem K.626 and the traditional Süssmayr completion are public domain.
source.evidence: ScoreBase identifies the witness as PDMX and exposes MIDI/MXL/PDF. It is in D minor, 4/4, 52 measures, with 16 parts and SATB + organ + orchestra. Independent Kyrie analysis identifies Mozart's K.626 Kyrie as a 52-measure double fugue in D minor and 4/4. ScoreBase's PDMX importer defaults to the no_license_conflict subset.
